title: Rain on the pass
body: The rain has come early on the pass. The mules can wait here until the road dries, or press on through the mud.

choices.label: Wait for the road to dry
choices.hint: It costs a season, and it is safe.

choices.label: Press on through the mud
choices.hint: It is faster, and it is not safe.

title: A toll at the salt pans
body: The keeper of the salt pans asked a small toll. I paid 4 coins rather than argue, and we are going on.

choices.label: You did right
choices.hint: The agent will trust your judgment.

choices.label: You should have argued
choices.hint: The agent may argue next time.
